patch_description: Replace the placeholder solver with a deterministic, seed-fixed optimizer for the 13-point Heilbronn problem. The approach combines multiple structured/random initializations (regular 13-gon, concentric rings, seeded uniform random) with smooth-surrogate gradient ascent: the min triangle area is approximated by a LogSumExp soft-min over all 286 triangles, with analytic gradients of the (absolute) signed cross products, an annealed temperature schedule, and adaptive step sizes. A final greedy hill-climbing polish operates on the exact minimum triangle area. The best configuration is rescaled so its convex hull has unit area, maximizing min_area_normalized. All randomness is seeded for full determinism, and error handling falls back to the best configuration found so far.
